scene: You step off the creaking lift onto a breezy wooden canopy platform.
picture: Side view of a level wooden platform between giant tree trunks. On far left, the open rope-bridge lift cage rests beside a hollow acorn postbox. Centre, the dark-haired boy in a green striped T-shirt holds his skateboard. Up high against the trunk sits a wooden ladder, while on the right a rope bridge extends outward.
shown: a hollow acorn postbox with letters poking out on the far left
a swaying rope suspension bridge leading right from the platform edge
a sturdy wooden ladder tied to the trunk going up high
